description.zh:
创建的AMQP订阅中的消费组ID，**Type**为**AMQP**时必填。

调用[CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~)创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用[QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~)按消费组名称查询消费组ID，也可以在物联网平台控制台<props="china"><ph>对应实例下</ph></props>，选择**消息转发**>**服务端订阅**>**消费组列表**，查看消费组ID。
description.en:
The consumer group ID in the created AMQP subscription. This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.

After you call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group successfully, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call [QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~) to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name. Alternatively, in the IoT Platform console<props="china"><ph>under the corresponding instance</ph></props>, navigate to **Message Forwarding** > **Server-side Subscription** > **Consumer Group List** to view the consumer group ID.

description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
标识当前订阅产品的其他类型消息。

- 如果订阅的是JT/T 808协议云网关产品，必须传入**SubscribeFlags**，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

- 如果订阅的是设备视频流状态变更通知消息，必须传入**SubscribeFlags**，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    配置AMQP服务端订阅**设备视频流状态变更通知**消息的详细内容，请参见[AMQP服务端订阅](~~2698782~~)。

- 如果同时订阅以上消息，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```
description.en:
Indicates other message types for the currently subscribed product.

- If you are subscribing to a JT/T 808 protocol cloud gateway product, you must pass **SubscribeFlags** with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

- If you are subscribing to device video stream status change notification messages, you must pass **SubscribeFlags** with the following value:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    For details on configuring server-side subscription via AMQP for **device video stream status change notifications**, see [AMQP Server-Side Subscription](~~2698782~~).

- If you subscribe to both of the above message types simultaneously, the value is:

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

title.en: Modify an MNS or AMQP server-side subscription

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

   > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.

   > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
